segments.name: BOA

segments.evidence: Delivering fit solutions purpose-built for performance, the BOA Fit System is featured in footwear across snow sports, cycling, outdoor, athletic, workwear as well as performance headwear and bracing.

segments.evidence: PrimaLoft Technologies Holdings, Inc. ("PrimaLoft") is a leading provider of branded, high-performance synthetic insulation and materials used primarily in consumer outerwear, and accessories.

segments.name: The Honey Pot Co.
segments.description: Sells plant-derived feminine hygiene, menstrual, personal care and sexual wellness products to consumers through mass, drug and grocery retailers.
segments.evidence: The Honey Pot Co. offers an extensive range of holistic wellness products across the feminine hygiene, menstrual, personal care, and sexual wellness categories.

segments.name: Velocity Outdoor
segments.description: Designs and sells archery products, crossbows and hunting apparel through national retail chains and dealer and distributor networks.
segments.evidence: Velocity Outdoor Inc. ("Velocity Outdoor" or "Velocity") is a leading designer, manufacturer, and marketer of archery products, hunting apparel and related accessories.

segments.name: Arnold
segments.description: Engineers and manufactures permanent magnets, motors, stators and precision foil products for aerospace, defense, industrial, medical and energy customers.
segments.evidence: Arnold engineers solutions for and produces high performance permanent magnets (PMAG), stators, rotors and full electric motors (Ramco), precision foil products (Precision Thin Metals), and flexible magnets (Flexmag) that are mission critical in motors, generators, sensors and other systems and components.

segments.name: Altor Solutions
segments.description: Makes custom molded protective foam and OEM components for appliance, electronics, pharmaceutical, automotive and building products manufacturers.
segments.evidence: FFI Compass, Inc. ("Altor Solutions" or "Altor") (formerly "Foam Fabricators"), headquartered in St. Louis, MO, is a designer and manufacturer of custom molded protective foam solutions and original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") components made from expanded polystyrene ("EPS") and other expanded polymers.

segments.name: Sterno
segments.description: Sells portable food warming, lighting and home fragrance products to consumer markets through Sterno Products and Rimports.
segments.evidence: Sterno is a leading manufacturer and marketer of portable food warming systems, creative indoor and outdoor lighting, and home fragrance solutions for the consumer markets.
